source_audit: tmp-audit.json (initial immutable audit; final tool rerun may exclude the checkpoint before candidate enumeration)
scope: Assigned stable-head checkpoint candidates plus other non-art candidate outputs; walk-palm/camera-forward/fist-combat/apollo-data handled by another reviewer.

reference_review.literal_search: Initial completed audit reports no literal references for these candidates. Additional bounded basename/extension/glob and producer/consumer inspection was used; this alone does not establish unused status.
reference_review.positive_output_evidence: Two recommended .log files are UBT build stdout. Two recommended JSON files are audit response copies matching the same-feature content-preservation.json. Existing integrity verification reads canonical evidence rather than tmp response copies.
bounded_search_scope: Relevant tmp root Arin verifier scripts
tmp authored scripts to depth 4 for distinctive Arin temporary basenames
tmp authored scripts to depth 3 for *.log/*.json patterns
additional_preserve_examples: tmp/effect-animation-reference/frames/frame_09.jpg and frame_16.jpg: prior preserve and contact.py glob input

limitations: Recommendation is a reviewed subset, not automatic deletion authorization. Root must revalidate current source/retained hashes and path safety immediately before any unlink.
No scripts, C++ source, checkpoint, Unreal assets, worktree, tool/runtime, prior-preserved input or zero-byte status marker is recommended for removal.
No whole-directory deletion and no semantic unused claim for unreviewed paths.
